plan.title: Withdraw Live RFQ with Valid Reason

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ event with one invited vendor bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer configuration.
Apply the required bidding-time rejection configuration.
Apply the required buyer bid-edit configuration.
Apply the required percentage counter-offer configuration.
Open the RFQ stage specified by the case.
Open the RFQ Responses tab before accessing Settings.
Verify the buyer is on the RFQ Responses view.
Use the RFQ stage Settings withdrawal flow and submit the valid reason.
Verify Procol records the RFQ stage as Withdrawn.
